title: Formal Conjectures (Solved Literature): Combinatorics & Graph Theory
description: Twenty-five known-in-literature, unproved-in-Lean combinatorics, graph theory, Ramsey, and discrete geometry theorems extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0), including Spencer's Six Standard Deviations, Montgomery–Pokrovskiy–Sudakov's Ringel/Kotzig theorem for large trees, Aharoni–Berger's infinite Menger theorem (Erdős #599), Nguyen–Scott–Seymour Erdős–Hajnal for P₅ (#61), Kim's triangle-free chromatic asymptotic (#920), Bucić–Sudakov (#813), and Pokrovskiy's Manickam–Miklós–Singhi bound. All statements compile cleanly on Lean 4.36.0 + Mathlib v4.36.0.
